description.value:
You center yourself, gather chakra, and refill an exhausted well. Choose how many actions to spend (1, 2, or 3); you regain that many expended spell slots (1, 2, or 3), distributed across any ranks of jutsu you can normally cast. You cannot regain a slot of higher rank than your maximum spell rank.

Frequency consumes one daily use of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-features.Item.ClFtChakraReser0]{Chakra Reserves} (shared with all Charge Chakra variants).

This is the first tier of three. At higher caster levels you unlock @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.spells.Item.SpllChrgChak2nd0]{Charge Chakra (Greater)} (level 7, 2x output ceiling) and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.spells.Item.SpllChrgChak3rd0]{Charge Chakra (Master)} (level 15, 3x output ceiling = up to 9 slots in one cast).
